query: The man is walking in the garden. Who does he come across?
oracle: A woman with gray suit and golden hair.

(Man, stands, near flowers)
(Man, walks, through garden)
(Man, looks up, towards sky)
(Man, stops, by grave)
(Man, turns, to face woman) 
(Woman, stands, with man)
(Man, moves, away from woman)

(Man, walks, along path) (Man, passes, under archway) (Man, pauses, on pathway) (Man, continues walking, down path) (Man, approaches, stone monument) (Man, steps onto, paved surface) (Man, begins moving, toward distant building)

(Man, stands, near rock formation) (Woman, walks, through garden) (Woman, looks, into distance) (Woman, turns, to face man) (Man, watches, woman walk away) (Man, stops, by doorway) (Man, observes, woman leaving)
